sourceCurrentBaseline.meaning: A matching country/subdivision code is treated as current in the pinned upstream release. A missing match is review-required unless an explicit historical rule applies.

model.administrativeLevel: Positive integer for administrative areas; null for settlements.
model.parentId: Country ID for source states; state ID for source cities.
model.validFromValidTo: ISO date when known, otherwise null. lifecycleStatus remains authoritative when dates are unavailable.

GB.note: The legacy state collection is a mixed local-administration layer; current level-1 nations are not represented as a clean canonical collection.

historicalRules.reason: Albania's districts were abolished as administrative units in 2000 and are absent from the pinned current subdivision baseline.

compatibility.migration: Legacy methods retain every source row. New canonical methods default to current source-state records and expose level/status/source-layer filters.
